text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the plaza, I bumped into
Bamboo Memory, who was clutching her head.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
To be honest, I went and reread the school regulations yesterday, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, just a little brag, but...
I've got the school regulations completely memorized!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As Disciplinary Committee Chairwoman,
I should know the school rules word for word!
However—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I wanted to re-memorize it, so I kept reading it over and over... and then, well, my head started spinning...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“Still, no need to worry!
The Disciplinary Committee Chairwoman won't lose to a mere headache—”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Ow-ow-oww!!
Ughhh... that wasn't cool at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory was troubled by a headache
for a while afterward.
